title: Safety and Privacy First
subtitle: Your baby’s sanctuary and your family’s privacy are protected with zero compromises.

cards.title: End-to-End Encrypted Streaming
cards.description: Video and two-way audio streams travel over direct encrypted TLS channels with zero open listening ports on your home network.

cards.title: Parent-Controlled Access
cards.description: Only verified parents hold primary administrative keys. You decide exactly who can view, listen, or control cradle soothing functions.

cards.title: Expiring Temporary Passes
cards.description: Grant babysitters or grandparents time-bound passes via QR code that expire automatically when their scheduled care window ends.

cards.title: Data Stays with Your Family
cards.description: Your newborn's biometric trends, cry audio, and sleep analytics belong to you. We never sell or monetize private nursery data to third parties.
